summary: Practise bank cash-flow forecasting, LCR and NSFR analysis, and contingency funding planning. Explore the course and strengthen your liquidity-risk practice.
lede: Bank liquidity risk management helps treasury, ALM and risk professionals assess whether funding can meet obligations as they fall due. Practical exercises cover cash-flow forecasting, liquidity-buffer analysis, funding concentration and balance-sheet gaps, alongside contingency funding actions and early-warning indicators. The course also introduces digital forecasting workflows, reporting controls and data governance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who analyze, control, review or oversee liquidity and balance-sheet risk in banks and financial institutions.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with bank financial statements, treasury or risk operations is recommended. No programming is required. Exercises use spreadsheet-based balance-sheet scenarios; any institution-specific data should be anonymized and approved for training use.
